entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv7958"/><div sID="gen12311" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv7958"/>10-31. This exquisite picture of a truly lovely wife is conceived and drawn in accordance with the customs of Eastern nations, but its moral teachings suit all climes. In Hebrew the verses begin with the letters of the Hebrew alphabet in order (compare Introduction to Poetical Books).<div eID="gen12311" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen12312" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">Who ... woman--</hi>The question implies that such are rare, though not entirely wanting (compare <reference osisRef="Prov.18.22">Pr 18:22</reference>; <reference osisRef="Prov.19.14">19:14</reference>).<div eID="gen12312" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen12313" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">virtuous--</hi>literally, "of strength," that is, moral courage (compare <reference osisRef="Prov.12.4">Pr 12:4</reference>; <reference osisRef="Ruth.3.11">Ru 3:11</reference>).<div eID="gen12313" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen12314" type="x-p"/><hi type="bold">her price, &c.--</hi>(compare <reference osisRef="Prov.3.15">Pr 3:15</reference>). <div eID="gen12314" type="x-p"/>
entries.content_plain: 10-31. This exquisite picture of a truly lovely wife is conceived and drawn in accordance with the customs of Eastern nations, but its moral teachings suit all climes. In Hebrew the verses begin with the letters of the Hebrew alphabet in order (compare Introduction to Poetical Books). Who ... woman-- The question implies that such are rare, though not entirely wanting (compare Pr 18:22 ; 19:14 ). virtuous-- literally, "of strength," that is, moral courage (compare Pr 12:4 ; Ru 3:11 ). her price, &c.-- (compare Pr 3:15 ).
